entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: You know curling irons? Those things[n]girls use to curl their hair?

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: There's a guy whose face got burned[n]real bad on 'em. I doubt even the doctors[n]can fix him up.

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: I've got a picture of him. Wanna see?

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: You know the guy you're looking for?[n]That's the sorta thing he does without[n]batting an eye...

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: He says, "Mind your own business."[n]And with that, my message is delivered.
